messages.subject: Shiny app wont deploy
parts:
I seem to be getting an unusual error. I am following exactly the tutorial:

http://docs.rstudio.com/shinyapps.io/getting-started.html#deploying-applications

Specifically, I am section 2.3 where I have configured rsconnect, made the ui and server files. After making these files a icon became active giving me the option to publish my files to the server. When I do so I get the following error:

Preparing to deploy application...DONE
Uploading bundle for application: 301465...DONE
Deploying bundle: 1274306 for application: 301465 ...
Waiting for task: 514380563
  building: Building image: 1282606
  error: Building package: digest
################################ Begin Task Log ################################ 
################################# End Task Log ################################# 
Error: Unhandled Exception: Child Task 514380564 failed: Error building image: Error building digest (0.6.15). R version 3.4.4 currently unavailable
Execution halted

I am using R Studio Version 1.1.442 on the Mac updated to high sierra

Can anyone point me in the right direction here

Chris

messages.subject: Re: Shiny app wont deploy
parts:
I'm getting a similar error, but with a different package: "Error building image: Error building withr (2.1.2). R version 3.4.4 currently unavailable".
This may be connected with me upgrading to R 3.4.4. Two days ago, with R 3.4.2, everything was fine.
Reverting back to R 3.2.2 I could deploy my app just fine.
